name: Right to be Caymanian -- Spouse/Civil Partner of a Caymanian

qualifying_event.description: The spouse or civil partner of a Caymanian may apply to the Caymanian Status and Permanent Residency Board for the right to be Caymanian, after 5 years (if the marriage predates 1 January 2004) or 7 years (if the marriage or civil partnership is from 1 January 2004 onward) immediately preceding the application (Immigration (Transition) Act, Section 28(5)).
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage/civil partnership certificate; proof of continuous cohabitation and residence; proof of spouse's/partner's Caymanian status.

requirements.blocker_text: Marriage to a Caymanian dating from before 1 January 2004 requires 5 years immediately preceding the application, legally/ordinarily resident throughout, with no separation exceeding 3 months during the qualifying period.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of qualifying marriage and residence.

requirements.blocker_text: The marriage/civil partnership must not be one of convenience; criminal-conviction restrictions apply.

requirement_groups.name: Marriage or civil partnership from 1 January 2004 onward

requirements.blocker_text: Marriage or civil partnership dating from 1 January 2004 onward requires 7 years immediately preceding the application, legally/ordinarily resident throughout, with no separation exceeding 3 months during the qualifying period.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 7 years of qualifying marriage/civil partnership and residence.

requirements.blocker_text: The marriage/civil partnership must not be one of convenience; criminal-conviction restrictions apply.

evidence_required.document: Proof of continuous cohabitation/residence throughout the qualifying period

sources.title: Cayman Islands Immigration (Transition) Act (2022 Revision) -- Section 28(5): spouse/civil partner of a Caymanian, 5-year (pre-2004 marriage) or 7-year (2004-onward) qualifying period; Section 28(7): surviving spouse/partner (7-year marriage duration); Section 33: revocation for marriage breakdown within 3 years of grant

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Cayman Islands' initial build. See ky_caymanian_status_descent.json's notes for why leads_to_citizenship is modelled as false. Modelled as two OR-groups (pre-2004 vs. 2004-onward marriage/partnership) since the Act itself splits the qualifying period on that date, not on any other distinguishing eligibility factor -- both groups share the same genuineness/character conditions, duplicated per this dataset's established convention for OR-groups with shared non-duration requirements. Section 28(7) additionally provides a surviving-spouse/partner ground requiring 7 years of marriage/partnership duration (not necessarily immediately preceding residence) -- not modelled as its own file since the Act frames it as a variant of this same marriage ground rather than a distinct legal mechanism, but flagged here as a real difference in the qualifying period's structure. Section 33 revocation grounds include marriage/partnership breakdown within 3 years of the grant -- a meaningful post-grant condition not modelled as a requirement but flagged since it affects the durability of this status.
